outline:
Objective：
1.	To widen the scope of knowledge of each graduate student by requiring him/her to participate in seminars related to and different from his/her research topic.
2.	To enable each graduate student to gain knowledge of what each other is doing in order to establish a sense of community.
3.	To develop/improve confidence in presentation skills and techniques.
